preceded_by = [[2009 in Bellator MMA|2009]]\n| followed_by = [[2011 in Bellator MMA|2011]]\n}}\n\n'''2010 in Bellator MMA''' was the second installment of the [[Bellator Fighting Championships]] (Bellator FC)-produced series. It started on April 8, 2010, and ended on June 24, 2010. Tournaments were held in the [[Featherweight (MMA)|featherweight]], [[Lightweight (MMA)|lightweight]], [[Welterweight (MMA)|welterweight]] and [[Middleweight (MMA)|middleweight]] divisions. The winner of each tournament will get a shot at the [[Bellator Fighting Championships#Current Champions|current Bellator Champion]] in his respective weight class. Three of the four current Bellator Champions also fought during this season in \"Super Fights\".{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/news/2010-02-16.html|title=MMA News - All Articles on Bellator MMA - Bellator.Spike.com|work=Spike.com}}{{Dead link|date=April 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} These non-tournament, non-title catch-weight fights were to help prepare the champions in defending their titles against the winners of this season's tournaments sometime in the third season.\n\n==Bellator 13==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=Bellator 13\n|image=\n|promotion=[[Bellator Fighting Championships]]\n|date=April 8, 2010\n|venue=[[Hard Rock Cafe|Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino]]\n|city=[[Hollywood, Florida]], United States\n|previousevent=[[Bellator 12]]\n|followingevent=[[Bellator 14]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 13''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on Thursday, April 8, 2010, at the [[Hard Rock Cafe|Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino]] in [[Hollywood, Florida]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=204919138 |title=Bellator XIII \u2013 Thursday, April 8, 2010 \u2013 Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood, Florida |publisher=bellator.com |access-date=2010-04-03 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110725063723/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=204919138 |archive-date=2011-07-25 }}{{cite web|url= http://www.bellator.com/news/2010-01-27.html|title= Bellator Fighting Championships returns to Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino four times in 2010|publisher=bellator.com |access-date=2010-01-27}} {{Dead link|date=October 2010|bot=H3llBot}}\n\n'''Background'''\n\nThe card featured two quarter-final bouts of the Featherweight and Lightweight tournaments Bellator is holding in its second season. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[FOX Sports Net]] and its regional sports network affiliates.\n\nJanne Tulirinta was originally set to fight [[Carey Vanier]], however, Tulirinta was forced out of the bout because of visa issues. The event took place on Thursday, June 24, 2010, at [[Fourth Street Live!]] in [[Louisville, Kentucky]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=204957242|title=Bellator XXIII Thursday June 24, 2010 Live at Fourth Street Live! However, Zachrich was forced to pull out of the fight for an undisclosed reason. He was replaced by UFC veteran, Johnny Rees. However, Rees was then replaced by Stoney Hale.\n\nKurt Kinser agreed to catchweight contest after Dave Overfield weighed-in well-over the 155-pound lightweight limit.{{cite The event took place on Thursday, September 9, 2010, at [[Mahalia Jackson Theater for the Performing Arts|Mahalia Jackson Theater]] in [[New Orleans, Louisiana]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=204985482|title=Bellator 28 Thursday, September 9, 2010 Mahalia Jackson Theater of the Performing Arts New Orleans, LA|publisher=Bellator.com|access-date=2010-09-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130502033909/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=204985482|archive-date=May 2, 2013|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[FOX Sports Net]] and its regional sports network affiliates. This was the first Bellator card with no Tournament Bouts.\n\n'''Background'''\n\nChas Skelly was expected to fight Georgi Karakhanyan in a fourth season featherweight tournament qualifier bout. However, Skelly injured himself during training and was forced to pull out of the bout. Skelly's replacement was to be UFC veteran, [[Alvin Robinson]].{{cite web|url=http://www.mmaweekly.com/absolutenm/templates/dailynews.asp?articleid=12159&zoneid=13|title=BELLATOR SIGNS UFC VET ALVIN ROBINSON|date=July 28, 2010}}{{dead link|date=July 2017 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} However, Robinson was also forced to pull out of the bout due to injury. Robinson was replaced by WEC veteran [[Anthony Leone (fighter)|Anthony Leone]].{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/20499/wec-vet-anthony-leone-replaces-injured-alvin-robinson-at-bellator-28.mma |title=WEC vet Anthony Leone replaces injured Alvin Robinson at Bellator 28 |publisher=MMAjunkie.com |date=September 1, 2010 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111108003518/http://mmajunkie.com/news/20499/wec-vet-anthony-leone-replaces-injured-alvin-robinson-at-bellator-28.mma |archive-date=2011-11-08 }}\n\nToney Canales and J.C. Pennington were set to fight, but for unknown reasons, the fight was pulled at the last minute.\n\nThe card took place in the same city and during the same night and time as the 2010 NFL season opener, a rematch of the NFC Championship game between the [[New Orleans Saints]] and the [[Minnesota Vikings]], a decision in MMA to counter-program a marquee NFL event which may have had adverse effect on local ticket sales.{{cite web|url=http://www.nola.com/saints/index.ssf/2010/08/championship_parade_in_new_orl.html|title=Championship Parade in New Orleans will kick-off NFL Season Sept. United States\n|previousevent=[[Bellator 28]]\n|followingevent=[[Bellator 30]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 29''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on Thursday, September 16, 2010, at [[The Rave]] in [[Milwaukee, Wisconsin]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=204990181|title=Bellator 29 Thursday September 16th, 2010 Rave Eagle Ballroom Milwaukee, WI|publisher=Bellator.com|access-date=2010-09-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130507115903/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=204990181|archive-date=2013-05-07|url-status=dead}} The card featured tournament fights in Bellator's third season. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[FOX Sports Net]] and its regional sports network affiliates.\n\n'''Background'''\n\nBellator 29 was the first sanctioned MMA event in Wisconsin.\n\nChico Camus was set to compete against [[Jameel Massouh]] in a catchweight bout. However, Camus injured his sternum in a car accident and was forced to withdraw from the bout.{{cite web| url=http://uscombatsports.com/wisconsin/201008311620/national-news/bellator-29-adds-jameel-massouh-vs-kyle-dietz-to-september-16-lineup.html| title=Bellator 29 Adds Jameel Massouh vs. Kyle Dietz to September 16 Lineup| publisher=uscombatsports.com| date=August 31, 2010| access-date=November 3, 2011| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100903142135/http://uscombatsports.com/wisconsin/201008311620/national-news/bellator-29-adds-jameel-massouh-vs-kyle-dietz-to-september-16-lineup.html| archive-date=September 3, 2010| url-status=dead| df=mdy-all}} Kyle Dietz was set to be Camus' replacement; however, an illness forced [[Ulysses Gomez]] out of his bout in the bantamweight tournament and [[Bryan Goldsby]], who was set to fight [[Nik Mamalis]], stepped in for Gomez and returned to the tournament. Dietz was dropped from the card, and Mamalis stepped in to fight Massoush.\n\nJustin Lemke was originally set to fight David Oliva, but Oliva was forced out of the bout due to weight issues.{{cite web| url=http://uscombatsports.com/wisconsin/201009111634/national-news/david-oliva-out-of-bellator-29-bellator-in-search-of-new-opponent-for-justin-lemke.html| title=David Oliva Out of Bellator 29, Officials in Search of New Opponent for Justin Lemke| publisher=uscombatsports.com| date=September 11, 2010| access-date=November 3, 2011| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100920162630/http://uscombatsports.com/wisconsin/201009111634/national-news/david-oliva-out-of-bellator-29-bellator-in-search-of-new-opponent-for-justin-lemke.html| archive-date=September 20, 2010| url-status=dead| df=mdy-all}} [[Jason Guida]] stepped in for Oliva as his replacement.{{cite web| url=http://uscombatsports.com/wisconsin/201009131639/national-news/jason-guida-replaces-oliva-for-bellator-29-bout-with-justin-lemke.html| title=Jason Guida Replaces Oliva for Bellator 29 Bout with Justin Lemke| publisher=uscombatsports.com| date=September 13, 2010| access-date=August 7, 2021| archive-date=September 26, 2021| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926131456/https://uscombatsports.com/wisconsin/201009131639/national-news/jason-guida-replaces-oliva-for-bellator-29-bout-with-justin-lemke.html| url-status=dead}}\n\nThe Massouh/Mamalis bout was originally contracted as a 140 lb catchweight fight. Massouh initially weighed in two pounds over the limit, but successfully made weight two hours after the original weigh-in on a subsequent attempt. Jason Guida weighed in five pounds over the 210 lb catchweight limit in his bout against Justin Lemke.{{cite web| \n| preceded_by = [[2010 in Bellator MMA|2010]]\n| followed_by = [[2012 in Bellator MMA|2012]]\n}}\n\n'''2011 in Bellator MMA''' was the fourth installment of the [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. [[Mixed martial arts]] tournaments were held in multiple [[Mixed martial arts weight classes|weight classes]], including three of the original tournament classes: Welterweight, Lightweight and Featherweight. There was also an inaugural Light Heavyweight Tournament taking place during this season, which crowned the first Light Heavyweight Champion in Bellator.{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/21814/bellator-announces-inaugural-light-heavyweight-tournament-for-fourth-season.mma |title=Bellator announces inaugural light heavyweight tournament for fourth season |publisher=MMAjunkie.com |date=2010-12-20 |access-date=2011-02-15 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110303224441/http://mmajunkie.com/news/21814/bellator-announces-inaugural-light-heavyweight-tournament-for-fourth-season.mma |archive-date=2011-03-03}} This was the first season to air on [[MTV2]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_LANG=C&DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205054922 |title=MTV2 AND BELLATOR AGREE TO 3-YEAR PARTNERSHIP |publisher=Bellator.com |date=2010-12-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120130212458/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_LANG=C&DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205054922 |archive-date=2012-01-30}}\n\n==Bellator 35==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=Bellator 35\n|image=\n|promotion=[[Bellator Fighting Championships]]\n|date=March 5, 2011\n|venue=Tachi Palace Hotel & Casino\n|city=[[Lemoore, California]]\n|previousevent=[[Bellator 34]]\n|followingevent=[[Bellator 36]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 35''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on March 5, 2011, at the Tachi Palace Hotel and Casino in [[Lemoore, California]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?&DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205092024|title=Bellator 35 \u2013 Lemoore, CA|publisher=bellator.com|access-date=2011-02-18|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110725065341/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?&DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205092024|archive-date=2011-07-25}} The card kicked off Bellator Season Four and featured opening round fights in the Season Four Welterweight Tournament. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nOn December 14, 2010, Bellator and [[MTV2]] announced a three-year deal to broadcast Bellator's tournaments and special events. This will be the first Bellator event to air on MTV2.\n\nBellator's Women's Strawweight Champion [[Zoila Frausto]] fought in a non-title catchweight bout against Karina Hallinan.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/22388/bellator-35-kicks-off-welterweight-tourney-four-quarterfinal-pairings-announced.mma|title=Bellator 35 kicks off welterweight tourney, four quarterfinal pairings announced|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-02-08|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111030084631/http://mmajunkie.com/news/22388/bellator-35-kicks-off-welterweight-tourney-four-quarterfinal-pairings-announced.mma|archive-date=2011-10-30}}\n\nAt this event [[Steve Carl]] was expected to fight [[Jay Hieron]] in the opening round of the welterweight tournament. However, Carl injured himself during training and was removed from the tournament. His replacement was [[Anthony Lapsley]].\n\nPoppies Martinez was expected to fight at this event,{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Bellator-Welterweight-Tourney-Starts-March-5-in-California-29684|title=Hieron and Carl possibly meet on March 5 |publisher=sherdog.com|date=2011-01-27}} but a bout never materialized.\n\nThe event drew an average of around 200,000 viewers on [[MTV2]]. Which helped MTV2 in several key advertising demographics including, an 83 percent increase among men aged 18 to 49, an 80 percent increase among men 18 to 34, and a 133 percent increase among men aged 25 to 34.{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Ratings-In-for-Strikeforce-on-Showtime-Bellators-MTV2-Debut-30717|title=Ratings In for Strikeforce on Showtime, Bellator's MTV2 Louisiana]]\n|previousevent=[[Bellator 35]]\n|followingevent=[[Bellator 37]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 36''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on March 12, 2011, at the [[Shreveport Municipal Auditorium]] in [[Shreveport, Louisiana]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205107871|title=Bellator 36|publisher=bellator.com|date=2011-03-06|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111006074053/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205107871|archive-date=2011-10-06}} The card featured opening-round fights in the Bellator Season Four Lightweight Tournament.{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Bellator-Lightweight-Tourney-Begins-March-12-30113|title=Bellator Lightweight Tourney Begins March 12|publisher=Sherdog.com|date=2010-12-12}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\n[[Toby Imada]] was originally scheduled to face French fighter [[Ferrid Kheder]]; however, Kheder refused to weigh in and [[Josh Shockley]] was moved up from the preliminary card to face Imada.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/22799/ferrid-kheder-refuses-to-weigh-in-josh-shockley-enters-bellators-lightweight-tournament.mma|title=Ferrid Kheder refuses to weigh in; Josh Shockley enters Bellator's lightweight tournament|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-03-11|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110818180055/http://mmajunkie.com/news/22799/ferrid-kheder-refuses-to-weigh-in-josh-shockley-enters-bellators-lightweight-tournament.mma|archive-date=2011-08-18}}\n\nShockley's original opponent, Kelvin Hackney, still weighed in, but was pulled off the card and paid his show money and win bonus. Hackney was expected to fight at [[Bellator 45]].{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/22809/with-bellator-36-fight-canceled-kelvin-hackney-paid-moved-to-bellator-45.mma|title=With Bellator 36 fight canceled, Kelvin Hackney paid, moved to Bellator 45|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-03-12|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111103172641/http://mmajunkie.com/news/22809/with-bellator-36-fight-canceled-kelvin-hackney-paid-moved-to-bellator-45.mma|archive-date=2011-11-03}}\n\nThe event drew an estimated 230,000 viewers on [[MTV2]].{{cite web |title=Bellator 41 ratings: Event draws season-low 132,000 viewers on MTV2 |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/23296/bellator-41-ratings-event-draws-season-low-132000-viewers-on-mtv2.mma |url-status=dead The event took place on March 26, 2011, at Harrah's Tunica Hotel and Casino in [[Tunica, Mississippi]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205107910|title=Bellator 38: Robinsonville, MS|publisher=Bellator.com|date=2011-03-01|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111006074258/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205107910|archive-date=2011-10-06}} The card featured the opening round fights in the Bellator Season Four Light Heavyweight Tournament. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nThis event showcased the inaugural light heavyweight tournament.\n\nOriginally, [[Blagoy Ivanov]] was set to fight John Brown on the undercard. However, Brown pulled out of the bout and was replaced by Johnathan Ivey. Ivey was then pulled off the card for a suspension by the Georgia Athletic Commission.{{cite web|url=http://prommanow.com/index.php/2011/03/22/brown-out-johnathan-ivey-steps-in-against-blagoi-ivanov-at-bellator-38/|title=Brown out, Ivey in then out at Bellator 38|publisher=prommanow.com|date=2011-03-22|access-date=2011-11-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111119041105/http://prommanow.com/index.php/2011/03/22/brown-out-johnathan-ivey-steps-in-against-blagoi-ivanov-at-bellator-38/|archive-date=2011-11-19|url-status=dead}} Ivanov instead fought William Penn.\n\nThe event drew an estimated 150,000 viewers on [[MTV2]].\n\n===Results===\n\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent card|Main card}}\n\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Light Heavyweight\n|Tim Carpenter\n|def.\n|Daniel Gracie\n|Split decision (29\u201328, 28\u201329, 29\u201328)\n|3\n|5:00\n|Light Heavyweight quarterfinal.\n}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Light Heavyweight\n|D.J. 41]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 40''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on April 9, 2011, at First Council Casino in [[Newkirk, Oklahoma]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205129084|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120514162906/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205129084|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-05-14|title=Champion Ben Askren Meets Nick \"The Goat\" Thompson in Non-Title Welterweight Superfight at Bellator 40|publisher=bellator.com|date=2011-02-16}} The card featured fights in the Welterweight and Lightweight Bellator Season Four Tournament. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nBellator Welterweight champion [[Ben Askren]] competed in a non-title bout against [[Nick Thompson (fighter)|Nick Thompson]] at this event.\n\nA lightweight semifinal bout between [[Toby Imada]] and [[Patricky Freire]] was originally set to take place on this card. However, the fight was moved to [[Bellator 39]] and replaced with the welterweight semifinal fight between [[Brent Weedman]] and [[Jay Hieron]]. The Hieron-Weedman fight was rescheduled because Weedman needed to receive clearance for a facial laceration suffered in his [[Bellator 35]] victory over [[Dan Hornbuckle]].[https://officialxfc.com/index.php/2011/03/good-vs-hawn-set-for-bellator-39-hieron-vs-weedman-planned-for-future-show/ Good vs. Hawn set for Bellator 39, Hieron vs. Weedman planned for future show]. Officialxfc.com (2011-03-08). Retrieved on 2011-04-05.\n\nFormer [[Sengoku]] fighter [[Ronnie Mann]] was expected to make his Bellator debut at this event.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/22658/ronnie-mann-vs-josh-arocho-targeted-for-bellator-40-on-april-9.mma |title=Ronnie Mann vs. Josh Arocho targeted for Bellator 40 on April 9 |publisher=MMAJunkie.com |date=2011-03-01 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111103162807/http://mmajunkie.com/news/22658/ronnie-mann-vs-josh-arocho-targeted-for-bellator-40-on-april-9.mma |archive-date=2011-11-03}} However, visa issues kept Mann from entering the United States and his fight has been pushed back to the [[Bellator 42]] card.[http://mmaweekly.com/visa-issues-delay-ronnie-manns-bellator-debut-pushed-back-to-april-23 Visa Issues Delay Ronnie Mann's Bellator Debut, Pushed Back to April 23]. MMAWeekly.com. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nBellator Heavyweight champion [[Cole Konrad]] was scheduled to compete in a non-title \"super fight\" bout against [[Paul Buentello]] at this event.[https://www.mmamania.com/2011/4/4/2090328/bellator-42-cole-konrad-vs-paul-buentello-superfight-booked-for-april Bellator 42: Cole Konrad vs Paul Buentello 'superfight' booked for April 23]. MMAmania.com. Retrieved on 2011-04-05. However, it was revealed that Buentello had to pull out of the bout due to a back injury.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/23294/buentello-out-of-bellator-42-headliner-mann-vs-arocho-takes-main-card-spot.mma|title=Buentello out of Bellator 42 headliner, Mann vs. Arocho takes main-card spot|publisher=MMAJunkie.com|date=2011-04-19|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111103170316/http://mmajunkie.com/news/23294/buentello-out-of-bellator-42-headliner-mann-vs-arocho-takes-main-card-spot.mma|archive-date=2011-11-03}}\n\nFormer [[Sengoku]] fighter [[Ronnie Mann]] was expected to make his Bellator debut at [[Bellator 40]]. However, visa issues kept Mann from entering the United States and the fight was moved to this card.\n\nChris Guillen was originally set to fight Mark Holata, but Guillen suffered a last minute injury and was replaced by Tracy Willis.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/23343/bellator-42-weigh-in-results.mma|title=Bellator 42 weigh-in results: Light-heavyweight semifinals official|publisher=MMAJunkie.com|date=2011-04-22|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111103170237/http://mmajunkie.com/news/23343/bellator-42-weigh-in-results.mma|archive-date=2011-11-03}}\n\nThe event drew an estimated 199,000 viewers on [[MTV2]].{{cite web|url=http://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/events/bellator-42|title=Bellator 42|work=Tapology}}\n\n===Results===\n\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent card|Main card}}\n\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Light Heavyweight\n|[[Rich Hale]]\n|def.\n|D.J. Cafe|Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino]]\n|city={{flagicon|USA}} [[Hollywood, Florida]]\n|previousevent=[[Bellator 45]]\n|followingevent=[[Bellator 47]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 46''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on June 25, 2011, at the [[Hard Rock Cafe|Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino]] in [[Hollywood, Florida]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205160668|title=Bellator 46|publisher=Bellator.com|date=2011-06-18|access-date=2011-11-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130502155458/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205160668|archive-date=2013-05-02|url-status=dead}} The card was part of Bellator's inaugural Summer Series and featured opening round fights in the Summer Series Tournament. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nThis event hosted the first round of an eight-man featherweight tournament to be held over the Summer Series.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/23345/pat-curran-drops-to-featherweight-scores-spot-in-bellators-summer-series-tourney.mma|title=Pat Curran drops to featherweight, scores spot in Bellator's \"Summer Series\" tourney|publisher=MMAJunkie.com|date=2011-04-22|access-date=2021-08-07|archive-date=2012-10-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121023172804/http://mmajunkie.com/news/23345/pat-curran-drops-to-featherweight-scores-spot-in-bellators-summer-series-tourney.mma|url-status=dead}}\n\nDavid Baggett missed the middleweight limit allowance of 186 for non-title fights, weighing in at 191.5 lb,{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/24119/bellator-46-weigh-in-results-tourney-quarterfinalists-all-on-weight.mma|title=Bellator 46 weigh-in results: Tourney quarterfinalists all on weight|publisher=MMAJunkie.com|date=2011-06-24|access-date=2021-08-07|archive-date=2012-11-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121109081407/http://mmajunkie.com/news/24119/bellator-46-weigh-in-results-tourney-quarterfinalists-all-on-weight.mma|url-status=dead}} and his bout with Moyses Gabin was scrapped from the card.\n\nThe event drew an estimated 185,000 viewers on [[MTV2]].[http://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/events/bellator-46-2011-summer-series-1 46]]\n|followingevent=[[Bellator 48]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 47''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on July 23, 2011, at [[Casino Rama]] in [[Rama, Ontario]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205180708|title=Bellator 47|publisher=Bellator.com|accessdate=2011-07-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130502094328/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205180708|archive-date=2013-05-02|url-status=dead}} The card featured semi-final fights in the Bellator 2011 Summer Series Featherweight Tournament. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nThis event was to feature Joe Warren's first defense of his featherweight title against season four tournament winner [[Patricio Freire]].{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/23894/bellator-47-headed-to-canada-on-july-23-ontarios-casino-rama-plays-host.mma|title=Bellator 47 headed to Canada on July 23, Ontario's Casino Rama plays host|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-06-07|access-date=August 7, 2021|archive-date=August 19, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120819070513/http://mmajunkie.com/news/23894/bellator-47-headed-to-canada-on-july-23-ontarios-casino-rama-plays-host.mma|url-status=dead}} Freire, however, pulled out of the fight in early July due to a broken hand.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/24277/patricio-pitbull-freire-out-of-bellator-47-with-broken-hand-title-fight-to-be-rebooked-for-fall.mma|title=Patricio \"Pitbull\" Freire out of Bellator 47 with broken hand, title fight to be rebooked for fall|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-07-05|access-date=2021-08-07|archive-date=2012-10-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121026100911/http://mmajunkie.com/news/24277/patricio-pitbull-freire-out-of-bellator-47-with-broken-hand-title-fight-to-be-rebooked-for-fall.mma|url-status=dead}}\n\nThis was Bellator's first event in Canada. [[Bellator 4]] was set to take place in Canada, but was moved due to the promotion unable to come to terms with the Quebec Boxing Commission.{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/MMA-Welcome-Says-Quebec-Commission-17628|title=MMA Welcome, Says Quebec Commission|publisher=sherdog.com|date=2009-05-26}}\n\n[[Ben Saunders (fighter)|Ben Saunders]] was expected to fight at this event,{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Saunders-Likely-Participant-for-Bellator-47-on-July-23-32751|title=Saunders Likely Participant for Bellator 47 on July 23|publisher=sherdog.com|date=2011-05-30}} but had to pull out due to an undisclosed injury he suffered in training.{{Cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Saunders-Sidelined-Scratched-from-Bellators-Canadian-Debut-33730|title=Saunders Sidelined, Scratched from Bellator\u2019s Canadian Debut|publisher=sherdog.com|date=2011-07-06}}\n\nBantamweights Bo Harris and [[Bryan Goldsby]] were originally announced to be facing each other,{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/24522/bezerra-vs-gross-matewa-vs-ricci-barnier-added-to-nine-bout-bellator-47-lineup.mma|title=Bezerra vs. Gross, Matewa vs. Ricci added to nine-bout Bellator 47 lineup|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-07-22|access-date=2021-08-07|archive-date=2012-11-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121109151647/http://mmajunkie.com/news/24522/bezerra-vs-gross-matewa-vs-ricci-barnier-added-to-nine-bout-bellator-47-lineup.mma|url-status=dead}} but the bout did not materialize in the days leading up to the event as Harris failed to complete his medical requirements in a timely fashion.\n\nThe event drew an estimated 277,000 viewers on [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on August 20, 2011, at the [[Mohegan Sun Arena]] in [[Uncasville, Connecticut]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205213637|title=Official Fight Card for Bellator 48|publisher=bellator.com|date=2011-07-27|access-date=2011-11-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130502012539/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205213637|archive-date=2013-05-02|url-status=dead}} The card was part of Bellator's inaugural Summer Series and featured the final round fights in the Summer Series Tournament. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nThis event hosted the final round of an eight-man featherweight tournament that was held over the Summer Series.\n\nJohn Clarke was expected to face [[Dan Cramer]], but an injury forced Clarke out of the bout. Jeff \"The Wolfman\" Nader stepped in as Clarke's replacement.[http://mmajunkie.com/news/24870/john-clarke-out-dan-cramer-faces-jeff-nader-at-bellator-48 John Clarke out; Dan Cramer faces Jeff Nader 2011}}\n|promotion=[[Bellator Fighting Championships]]\n|date=September 10, 2011\n|venue=[[Caesars Atlantic City]]\n|city={{flagicon|USA}} [[Atlantic City, New Jersey]]\n|previousevent=[[Bellator 48]]\n|followingevent=[[Bellator 50]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 49''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on September 10, 2011, at [[Caesars Atlantic City]] in [[Atlantic City, New Jersey]].{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/24322/bellator-49-hosts-season-five-welterweight-tourney-eight-man-bracket-revealed.mma|title=Bellator 49 hosts season-five welterweight tourney; eight-man bracket revealed|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-07-08|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111102045206/http://mmajunkie.com/news/24322/bellator-49-hosts-season-five-welterweight-tourney-eight-man-bracket-revealed.mma|archive-date=2011-11-02}} The card was the debut of the promotion's fifth season and distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nThis event hosted the first round of an eight-man welterweight tournament to be held over the duration of Bellator's fifth season.{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205241195|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111025011912/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205241195|url-status=dead|archive-date=2011-10-25|title=Bellator 49 Official Fight Card|publisher=Bellator.com|date=2011-08-12}}\n\n[[Rick Hawn]] was expected to face [[Ben Saunders (fighter)|Ben Saunders]] at this event but Hawn was forced out of the bout due to a knee injury.{{Cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Hawn-Injures-Knee-Withdraws-from-Bellator-Tournament-34833|title=Hawn Injures Knee, Withdraws from Bellator Tournament|access-date=17 August 2011}} Hawn was replaced by Bellator newcomer Chris Cisneros.{{Cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/24893/with-rick-hawn-out-chris-cisneros-enters-bellators-season-five-tourney.mma|title=With Rick Hawn out, Chris Cisneros enters Bellator's season-five tourney|publisher=mmajunkie.com|access-date=20 August 2011|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111020200738/http://mmajunkie.com/news/24893/with-rick-hawn-out-chris-cisneros-enters-bellators-season-five-tourney.mma|archive-date=20 October 2011}}\n\n[[The Ultimate Fighter 12]] competitor, [[Andy Main]], was set to fight [[Kenny Foster]] on the undercard of this event. However, after an undisclosed injury, Main was pulled from the bout.{{Cite web|url=http://mmaweekly.com/former-tuf-competitor-andy-main-out-of-bellator-49-due-to-injury|title=Former TUF Competitor Andy Main Out of Bellator 49 Due to Injury|publisher=mmaweekly.com|access-date=25 August 2011}}\n\nOn September 6, 2011, it was announced Bellator's Season 5 \"Local Feature Fights\" would be streamed on Spike.com|work=Sherdog}}\n\nThe event drew an estimated 235,000 viewers on [[MTV2]].{{cite web|url=http://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/events/10058-bellator-49|title=Bellator The event took place on September 17, 2011, at the [[Hard Rock Cafe|Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino]] in [[Hollywood, Florida]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205241196|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110826065528/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205241196|url-status=dead|archive-date=2011-08-26|title=Bellator 50 Official Fight Card|publisher=Bellator.com|date=2011-08-12}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nThe event hosted the opening round of the middleweight tournament in Bellator's fifth season.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/24595/bellator-50-baker-vs-hess-galesic-vs-shlemenko-alvey-vs-vianna-odonnell-vs-rogers.mma|title=Bellator 50: Baker vs. Hess, Galesic vs. Shlemenko, Alvey vs. Vianna, O'Donnell vs. Rogers|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-07-28|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111019075553/http://mmajunkie.com/news/24595/bellator-50-baker-vs-hess-galesic-vs-shlemenko-alvey-vs-vianna-odonnell-vs-rogers.mma|archive-date=2011-10-19}}\n\nVeteran welterweight fighter Ailton Barbosa won Bellator's open tryouts in [[Hollywood, Florida]] in June 2011 to earn his spot on the card.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/24078/ailton-barbosa-wins-bellator-open-tryout-earn-spot-on-bellator-50-card.mma|title=Ailton Barbosa wins Bellator open tryout, earns spot on Bellator 50 card|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-06-21|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111103160922/http://mmajunkie.com/news/24078/ailton-barbosa-wins-bellator-open-tryout-earn-spot-on-bellator-50-card.mma|archive-date=2011-11-03}}\n\nR.J. Goodridge was scheduled to fight [[J. P. Reese]], but after suffering an undisclosed injury Goodridge pulled out of the bout and was replaced by Martin Brown.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/25252/luis-palomino-scratched-from-bellator-50-prelims-undergo-other-changes.mma|title=Luis Palomino scratched from Bellator 50, prelims undergo other changes|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2011-09-15|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111019141146/http://mmajunkie.com/news/25252/luis-palomino-scratched-from-bellator-50-prelims-undergo-other-changes.mma|archive-date=2011-10-19}} Also, Ryan Hodge was scheduled to fight Valdir Araujo, but was pulled from the bout with an injury, and replaced with [[Brett Cooper (fighter)|Brett Cooper]].\n\nOn September 15, 2011, [[Luis Palomino]] suffered an injury in training and was pulled from his scheduled bout with James Edson Berto. Berto was later pulled from the card as well, and the fight was scratched altogether; The two then met at W-1: Reloaded in which Palomino defeated Berto.\n\nA scheduled lightweight bout between Dietter Navarro and Marcelo Goncalves was changed into a 156 lb catchweight bout after both fighters missed weight.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/25269/bellator-50-weigh-in-results-middleweight-tourney-fighters-all-on-weight.mma|title=Bellator 50 weigh-in results: Middleweight-tourney fighters all on The event took place on September 24, 2011, at the [[Canton Memorial Civic Center]] in [[Canton, Ohio]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205241252|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111025030748/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205241252|url-status=dead|archive-date=2011-10-25|title=Bellator 51 Saturday September 24th, 2011 Canton Civic Center Canton, OH|publisher=Bellator.com|access-date=2011-09-01}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nThis event hosted the first round of an eight-man bantamweight tournament to be held over the course of Bellator's fifth season.{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Bellator-Sets-Season-5-Bantamweight-Quarterfinals-for-Sept-24-33556|title=Bellator Sets Season 5 Bantamweight Quarterfinals for Sept. 24|publisher=sherdog.com|date=2011-06-28}}\n\n[[Joe Soto]] was originally scheduled to face [[Eduardo Dantas]] in the opening round of the bantamweight-tournament. However, he was pulled from the bout after losing to Eddie Yagin at [[Tachi Palace Fights 10]] and replaced by [[Wilson Reis]].{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/25014/wilson-reis-replaces-joe-soto-meets-eduardo-dantas-in-bellator-51-tourney-fight.mma|title=Wilson Reis replaces Joe Soto, meets Eduardo Dantas in Bellator 51 Jessica Eye-Casey Noland bout was changed from 125 lb to a 127 lb catchweight after Noland failed to make weight.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/25375/bellator-51-weigh-in-results-bantamweight-tourney-fighters-all-on-weight.mma|title=Bellator 51 weigh-in results: Bantamweight-tourney fighters all on [[Thiago Santos (fighter)|\nThiago Santos]] stepped in for the injured Hayes.{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Big-Monster-Santos-Replaces-Hayes-in-Bellator-HW-Tourney-36338|title=\u2018Big Monster\u2019 Santos Replaces Hayes in Bellator HW Tourney|publisher=Sherdog.com|date=2011-10-10}} Ivanov subsequently had to pull out of the bout due to an injury and was replaced by [[Neil Grove]].{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/25728/blagoi-ivanov-out-neil-grove-back-in-heavyweight-tourney-at-bellator-56.mma|title=Blagoi Ivanov out, Neil Grove back in heavyweight tourney at Bellator 56|publisher=MMAJunkie.com|date=2011-10-19|access-date=2021-08-07|archive-date=2011-10-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111021223107/http://mmajunkie.com/news/25728/blagoi-ivanov-out-neil-grove-back-in-heavyweight-tourney-at-bellator-56.mma|url-status=dead}}\n\n===Results===\n\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent card|Main card}}\n\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Welterweight\n|[[Ben Askren]] (c)\n|def.\n|[[Jay Hieron]]\n|Split decision (47-48, 48-47, 48-47)\n|5\n|5:00\n|For the Bellator Welterweight Championship.\n}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Heavyweight\n|[[Thiago Santos]]\n|def.\n|[[Neil Grove]]\n|Submission (rear-naked choke)\n|1\n|0:38\n|Heavyweight semifinal.\n}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Heavyweight\n|Eric Prindle\n|def.\n|Ron Sparks\n|KO (Punch)\n|1\n|0:40\n|Heavyweight semifinal.\n}}\n{{MMAevent card|Local Feature Fight (Spike.com)|header=no}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Welterweight\n|Marcio Navarro\n|def.\n|Rudy Bears\n|Split decision (29-28, 27-30, 29-28)\n|3\n|5:00\n}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Featherweight\n|Jeremy Spoon\n|def.\n|Adam Schindler\n|Unanimous decision\n|3\n|5:00\n|This bout aired on MTV2 following the Prindle/Sparks match.\n}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Light Heavyweight\n|Kelvin Tiller\n|def.\n|Dan Spohn\n|Split decision (30-27, 28-29, 29-28)\n|3\n|5:00\n}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Lightweight\n|E.J. 59\n|image=\n|promotion=[[Bellator Fighting Championships]]\n|date= November 26, 2011\n|venue=[[Caesars Atlantic City]]\n|city={{flagicon|USA}} [[Atlantic City, New Jersey]]\n|previousevent=[[Bellator 58]]\n|followingevent=[[Bellator 60]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 59''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. It took place on November 26, 2011, at [[Caesars Atlantic City]] in [[Atlantic City, New Jersey]].{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205322244|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120127181557/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205322244|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-01-27|title=Bellator 59 Official Fight Card|publisher=Bellator.com|access-date=2011-10-25}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n===Background===\n\nThis event hosted the final round of [[Bellator Fighting Championships: Season Five#Bantamweight tournament bracket|Bellator's Season Five Bantamweight Tournament]] as well as the [[Bellator Fighting Championships: Season Five#Heavyweight tournament bracket|Bellator's Season Five Heavyweight Tournament]].\n\nMichael Costa pulled out of his fight with [[Lyman Good]] due to an injury, which led the organization to scrap Good from the event all together. The lightweight bout between [[Phillipe Nover]] and [[Marcin Held]] was promoted to the main card.{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Costa-Injured-Bout-with-Good-Scratched-from-Bellator-59-Card-37447|title= Costa Injured, Bout with Good Scratched from Bellator 59 Card|publisher=Sherdog.com|access-date=2011-11-23}}\n\nThe final of the Heavyweight tournament was ruled a No Contest after an accidental groin kick by [[Thiago Santos (heavyweight fighter)|Thiago Santos]] rendered [[Eric Prindle]] unable to continue. Following the event Santos failed to make weight for a scheduled rematch causing the bout to be cancelled, and Prindle to be awarded the tournament win by default.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27948/bellator-62-weigh-in-results.mma|title=Bellator 62 weigh-in results: Thiago Santos heavy, Prindle awarded tournament win|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=February 22, 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120503214843/http://mmajunkie.com/news/27948/bellator-62-weigh-in-results.mma|archive-date=May 3, 2012}}\n\n===Results===\n\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent card|Main card}}\n\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Heavyweight\n|Eric Prindle \n|vs.\n|[[Thiago Santos]]\n|No contest (kick to groin)\n|1\n|1:24\n|Heavyweight tournament final. web|url=http://www.bellator.com/Schedule.dbml?DB_LANG=C&&DB_OEM_ID=23600|title=Schedule \u2013 Bellator Fighting Championships|publisher=Bellator.com|access-date=2011-11-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111026085512/http://www.bellator.com/Schedule.dbml?DB_LANG=C&&DB_OEM_ID=23600|archive-date=October 26, 2011|url-status=dead}} which began on March 9, 2012.{{cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/sports/mma/post/2011-12-05/bellator-relocates-to-friday-for-season-6/578136/1?|title=Bellator Relocates To Friday For Season 6|publisher=usatodaycom|access-date=2011-12-05|date=December 5, 2011}} The sixth season of Bellator was originally scheduled to begin on March 2, 2012. However, the debut was pushed back a week so it began with the show on March 9, 2012.{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27061/bellators-sixth-season-pushed-back-a-week-bellator-60-slotted-for-march-9-in-indiana.mma |title=Bellator's sixth season pushed back a week, Bellator 60 slotted for 2012 |url-status=dead |df=mdy-all }}\n\n[[Mixed martial arts]] tournaments were held in five [[Mixed martial arts weight classes|weight classes]], including the bantamweight,{{cite web|url=http://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Galvao-to-Feature-in-Bellator-Season-6-Bantamweight-Tournament-38091|title=Galvao to Feature in Bellator Season 6 Bantamweight Tournament|publisher=Sherdog.com|date=2011-12-13}} featherweight, lightweight, welterweight and middleweight divisions.\n\n==Bellator 60==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=Bellator 60\n|image=\n|date= March 9, 2012\n|venue= The Venue at Horseshoe Casino\n|city= [[Hammond, Indiana]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 60''''' took place on March 9, 2012 at The Venue at Horseshoe Casino in Hammond, Indiana.{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?&DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205365236|title=Bellator 60|publisher=Bellator.com|access-date=2012-01-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121023032016/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?&DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205365236|archive-date=October 23, 2012|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n'''Background'''\n\nBellator 60 was expected to take place on March 2, but the season opener was pushed back one week.{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27061/bellators-sixth-season-pushed-back-a-week-bellator-60-slotted-for-march-9-in-indiana.mma |title=Bellator's sixth season pushed back 2012 |url-status=dead |df=mdy-all }}\n\n[[Wagnney Fabiano]] was originally scheduled to face [[Ronnie Mann]] in the opening round of the Featherweight tournament; however, on March 1, 2012, Fabiano pulled out of the bout and was replaced by [[Mike Corey]].{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27648/wagnney-fabiano-scratches-mike-corey-takes-tourney-slot-at-bellator-60.mma |title=Wagnney Fabiano scratches, Mike Corey takes tourney slot at Bellator 60 |publisher=MMAJunkie.com |date=2012-03-01 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120302232414/http://mmajunkie.com/news/27648/wagnney-fabiano-scratches-mike-corey-takes-tourney-slot-at-bellator-60.mma |archive-date=March 2, 2012 |df=mdy-all }}\n\n[[Genair da Silva]] was originally scheduled to face [[Alexandre Bezerra]] in the opening round of the Featherweight tournament; however, after weigh-in issues, da Silva was forced to pull out of the bout. He was replaced by [[Kenny Foster]] who was set to fight Bobby Reardanz on the undercard of this event.{{cite web|url=http://fcfighter.com/post/kenny-foster-replaces-genair-da-silva-in-bellator-featherweight-tournament-kick-off |title=Kenny Foster Replaces Genair da Silva in Bellator Featherweight Tournament end|notes=yes}}\n\n== Bellator 61 ==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=Bellator 61\n|image=\n|date= March 16, 2012\n|venue= Horseshoe Riverdome\n|city= [[Bossier City, Louisiana]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 61''''' took place on March 16, 2012 at Horseshoe Riverdome in Bossier City, Louisiana.{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205369403|title=Bellator 61|publisher=Bellator.com|access-date=2012-02-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120422034647/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205369403|archive-date=April 22, 2012|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n'''Background'''\n\nThe event was to feature the rematch between season-five heavyweight tournament finalists [[Eric Prindle]] and [[Thiago Santos (fighter)|Thiago Santos]]. Prindle and Santos met in the finals of Bellator's season-five heavyweight tourney, but the bout was ruled a no-contest when Santos inexplicably kicked a downed Prindle in the groin.{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27162/louisiana-hosts-bellator-61-heavyweight-tourney-finale-rematch.mma |title=Louisiana hosts Bellator 61, heavyweight tourney finale rematch |publisher=MMAJunkie.com |access-date=2012-01-27 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120204140310/http://mmajunkie.com/news/27162/louisiana-hosts-bellator-61-heavyweight-tourney-finale-rematch.mma |archive-date=February 4, 2012 |df=mdy-all }} However, on March 15, Bellator announced the fight had been pushed back a week to Bellator 62 due to Prindle having \"flu-like symptoms.\"{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27850/bellator-61-headliner-eric-prindle-likely-to-scratch-with-flu-like-symptoms.mma |title=Bellator 61 headliner Eric Prindle scratches with flu-like symptoms, pushed to Bellator 62 |publisher=MMAJunkie.com |access-date=2012-03-15 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120317053516/http://mmajunkie.com/news/27850/bellator-61-headliner-eric-prindle-likely-to-scratch-with-flu-like-symptoms.mma |archive-date=March 17, 2012 |df=mdy-all }}\n\nThis event marked the first time that [[Bellator Fighting Championships]] aired in [[Brazil]] on [[TV Esporte Interativo]].\n\n===Results===\n\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent card|Main [[Laredo, Texas]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 62''''' took place on March 23, 2012 at Laredo Energy Arena in Laredo, Texas. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n'''Background'''\n\nThe event hosted the opening round of Bellator's Season Six Lightweight Tournament.{{cite web|url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205373682|title=Bellator 62|publisher=bellator.com|date=2012-02-17|access-date=February 17, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130425073833/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205373682|archive-date=April 25, 2013|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}}\n\n[[Eric Prindle]] and [[Thiago Santos (fighter)|Thiago Santos]] were supposed to have their rematch of the Season Five Heavyweight Tournament Final on this card, after having been delayed a week from Bellator 61. Santos, however, failed to make weight and the bout was cancelled, and Prindle was awarded the tournament win by default. A scheduled fight between [[Cosmo Alexandre]] and Oscar de la Parra was also scrapped.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27948/bellator-62-weigh-in-results.mma|title=Bellator 62 weigh-in results: Thiago Santos heavy, Prindle awarded tournament win|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2012-02-22|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120503214843/http://mmajunkie.com/news/27948/bellator-62-weigh-in-results.mma|archive-date=May 3, 2012|df=mdy-all}}\n\n===Results===\n\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent card|Main card}}\n\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Lightweight\n|Lloyd Woodard\n|def.\n|[[Patricky Freire]]\n|Submission (kimura)\n|2\n|1:46\n|Lightweight tournament quarterfinal.\n}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Lightweight\n|[[Rick Hawn]]\n|def.\n|Ricardo Tirloni\n|KO (punches)\n|1\n|2:36\n|Lightweight tournament quarterfinal.\n}}\n{{MMAevent bout\n|Lightweight\n|Brent Weedman\n|def.\n|J.J. Marcin Held on May 11|publisher=MMADieHards.com |date=2012-02-18}} However, on March 13, Pellegrino suffered a knee injury and was forced to pull out of the bout.{{cite web|url=http://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Kurt-Pellegrino-Injured-Out-of-Planned-Bellator-68-Scrap-with-Marcin-Held-in-Atlantic-City-41065|title=Kurt Pellegrino Injured, Out of Planned Bellator 68 Scrap with Marcin Held in Atlantic City|publisher=Sherdog.com |date=2012-03-13}} [[Phillipe Nover]] had stepped in as Pellegrino's replacement, but was eventually replaced by Bellator newcomer Derrick Kennington.\n\nEddie Fyvie and [[Jeff Lentz]] were originally scheduled to compete in a featherweight bout; however, the fight did not materialize.\n\n[[Marius \u017daromskis]] versus [[Waachiim Spiritwolf]] was originally going to be contested at welterweight; however, Spiritwolf failed to make the 171 pounds cut off allowance and the fight was changed to a catchweight bout at 172 pounds.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/28643/bellator-68-weigh-in-results.mma|title=Bellator 68 weigh-in results: Co-headlining tourney fighters on weight|publisher=MMAjunkie.com|date=2012-05-10|access-date=May 10, 2012|archive-date=May 13, Marrero]] and [[Seth Petruzelli]] was cancelled the day of the show due to an illness by Petruzelli.{{cite Louisiana]]\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 69''''' took place on May 18, 2012 at the L'Auberge du Lac Casino Resort in [[Lake Charles, Louisiana]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?ATCLID=205411079&DB_OEM_ID=23600 |title=Bellator 69 \u2013 L'Auberge Casino Lake Charles, LA \u2013 Bellator Fighting Championships web|url=http://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Bellator-69-Gets-Lightweight-Tournament-Final-FujiiAguilar-Heavyweight-Qualifier-41727|title=Bellator 69 Gets Lightweight Tournament Final, Fujii/Aguilar, Bellator Season Seven Heavyweight tournament. However, the bout was cancelled the day of the show due to Sparks feeling ill.\n\nWith [[Hector Lombard]] leaving for the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]],{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/28415/bellator-champ-hector-lombard-signs-with-ufc.mma|title=Bellator champ Hector Lombard signs with UFC|author=MMAjunkie.com Staff|date=April 24, 2012|publisher=mmajunkie.com|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120426212545/http://mmajunkie.com/news/28415/bellator-champ-hector-lombard-signs-with-ufc.mma|archive-date=April 26, 2012|df=mdy-all}} the Middleweight title was vacated. On April 25, 2012, Bellator CEO Bjorn Rebney announced that the winner of the Middleweight tournament finale between [[Maiquel Falc\u00e3o]] and [[Andreas Spang]] will face [[Alexander Shlemenko]] to crown the company's new Middleweight champion.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/28428/rebney-falcao-vs-spang-winner-meets-shlemenko-for-bellators-vacant-middleweight-title.mma |title=Rebney: The event took place on July 20, 2012 at [[USF Sun Dome]] in [[Tampa, Florida]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=23600&ATCLID=205435842 |title=Bellator 72 fight.\n\n[[Marius \u017daromskis]] and [[Waachiim Spiritwolf]] competed in a rematch - their third fight together - following a controversial doctor stoppage in their previous Bellator fight in May 2012.\n\nA heavyweight bout between Chris Barnett and Tom Sauer was initially announced by the promotion for this card.{{cite web |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/news/bellator-72-schedule-july-20-2012-072500187--mma.html |title=Bellator 72 Schedule for July 20, 2012 |publisher=yahoo.com |date=2012-07-20}} However, the bout failed Series#Bellator 72|Bellator 72]]\n|followingevent=\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 73''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Bellator Fighting Championships]]. The event took place on August 24, 2012 at Harrah's Tunica Hotel and Casino in [[Tunica, Mississippi]].{{cite web|url=http://www.sherdog.com/events/BFC-Bellator-Fighting-Championships-73-22619|title=Bellator 73 |publisher=sherdog.com |date=2012-05-28}} {{cn span|text=The card was part of Bellator's annual Summer Series and featured the final round fights in the Summer Series Tournament.|date=August 2021}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n'''Background'''\n\nThis fight card was to feature [[Pat Curran (fighter)|Pat Curran]] making the first defense of his Featherweight title against Bellator season 4 [[Bellator Fighting Championships: Season Four#Featherweight tournament bracket|Featherweight tournament winner]] [[Patricio Freire]]. However, on August 14, 2012, it was announced that Curran had suffered an injury and the bout was to be rescheduled for a later date.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/30194/with-champ-curran-injured-bellator-73s-pitbull-awaits-replacement-hopes-for-warren.mma|title=With champ Curran injured, Bellator 73's 'Pitbull' awaits replacement, hopes for Warren|publisher=MMAjunkie.com|date=2012-08-15|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120818001042/http://mmajunkie.com/news/30194/with-champ-curran-injured-bellator-73s-pitbull-awaits-replacement-hopes-for-warren.mma|archivedate=2012-08-18}}\n\nThe card featured the finals of the season 6 [[Bellator Fighting Championships: Season Six#Bantamweight tournament bracket|Bantamweight tournament]] and 2012 Summer Series [[Bellator Fighting Championships: 2012 Summer Series#Light Heavyweight tournament bracket|Light Heavyweight tournament]].\n\nMarcus \"Lelo\" Aurelio was originally supposed to make his promotional debut on this card, but was removed due to an injury. His original opponent, Amaechi Oselukwue, instead met replacement [[Kelvin Tiller]].{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/30197/lelo-aurelio-scratches-from-bellator-73-oselukwue-now-meets-tiller.mma|title='Lelo' Aurelio scratches from Bellator 73, Oselukwue now meets Tiller|publisher=MMAjunkie.com|date=2012-08-15|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120818050057/http://mmajunkie.com/news/30197/lelo-aurelio-scratches-from-bellator-73-oselukwue-now-meets-tiller.mma|archivedate=2012-08-18}} September 28, 2012 at Caesars Atlantic City in Atlantic City, New Jersey.|date=August 2021}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]]. It was the season debut of season seven.\n\n'''Background'''\n\nBellator 74 hosted the opening round in the Bellator Season Seven Welterweight Tournament.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/30181/bellator-74-main-card-set-with-welterweight-tourney-good-wallhead-headliner.mma|title=Bellator 74 main card set with welterweight tourney, Good-Wallhead headliner|publisher=MMAjunkie.com|date=August 14, 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120819065639/http://mmajunkie.com/news/30181/bellator-74-main-card-set-with-welterweight-tourney-good-wallhead-headliner.mma|archive-date=August 19, 2012|df=mdy-all}}\n\n[[Alexandre Bezerra]] was originally scheduled to face [[The Ultimate Fighter: Live]] alumni Jeff Smith. However, Smith failed his pre-fight medical and was replaced by Matt McCook in a 157 lb catchweight fight.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/30832/bellator-74-weigh-in-results.mma|title=Bellator 74 weigh-in results|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=September 28, Casino]]\n|city= [[Hammond, Indiana]]\n}}\n\n{{cn span|text='''''Bellator 75''''' took place on October 5, 2012 at The Venue in the [[Horseshoe Casino Hammond|Horseshoe Casino]] in [[Hammond, Indiana]].|date=August 2021}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n'''Background'''\n\n{{cn span|text=Bellator 75 hosted the opening round in the Bellator Season Seven Heavyweight Tournament.|date=August 2021}}\n\nThe event featured the long-planned rematch between season-five heavyweight tournament finalists [[Eric Prindle]] and [[Thiago Santos (fighter)|Thiago Santos]]. Prindle and Santos met in the finals of Bellator's season-five heavyweight tourney, but the bout was ruled a no-contest when Santos inexplicably kicked a downed Prindle in the groin.{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27162/louisiana-hosts-bellator-61-heavyweight-tourney-finale-rematch.mma |title=Louisiana hosts Bellator 61, heavyweight tourney finale rematch |publisher=MMAJunkie.com |access-date=January 27, 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120204140310/http://mmajunkie.com/news/27162/louisiana-hosts-bellator-61-heavyweight-tourney-finale-rematch.mma |archive-date=February 4, 2012 |df=mdy-all }} The initial rematch was scheduled for Bellator 61. However, on March 15, Bellator announced the fight had been pushed back a week to Bellator 62 due to Prindle having \"flu-like symptoms.\" The following week Santos failed to make weight and the bout was cancelled, and Prindle was awarded the tournament win by default.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/27948/bellator-62-weigh-in-results.mma|title=Bellator 62 weigh-in results: Thiago Santos heavy, Prindle awarded tournament win|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=February 22, 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120503214843/http://mmajunkie.com/news/27948/bellator-62-weigh-in-results.mma|archive-date=May 3, 2012|df=mdy-all}} Incredibly, the fourth scheduled meeting of these two fighters again ended in controversy as this time Prindle accidentally kicked Santos in the groin in round one.\n\n'''Results'''\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent between finalists [[Shahbulat Shamhalaev]] and [[Rad Martinez]].{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/31583/tourney-finals-flip-flop-with-lightweights-headed-to-bellator-84-featherweights-to-bellator-83.mma|title=Tourney finals flip-flop with lightweights headed to 16, 2012|df=mdy-all}} However, the night of the show it was announced on the air that the bout was cancelled due to Shamhalaev having food poisoning. The fight was initially moved to the following week's show,{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/bellator-83-results-food-poisoning-moves-featherweight-final-to-bellator-84|title=Food later postponed to season eight.{{cite web|url=http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/bellators-rad-martinez-shahbulat-shamhalaev-tourney-final-moved-to-season-8|title=Bellator's Rad Martinez-Shahbulat web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/31585/christian-mpumbu-defends-light-heavyweight-title-vs-attila-vegh-at-bellator-84-in-indiana.mma|title=Christian M'Pumbu defends light heavyweight title vs. Attila 16, 2012|df=mdy-all}} The event was distributed live in prime time by [[MTV2]].\n\n'''Background'''\n\nBellator 84 hosted the final of Bellator's Season Seven Heavyweight and Lightweight Tournaments.\n\n[[Christian M'Pumbu]] was expected to make his first defense of his light heavyweight title against [[Bellator Fighting Championships: 2012 Summer Series|2012 Summer Series]] tournament winner [[Attila Vegh (fighter)|Attila Vegh]]. However, on December 3, 2012, it was announced that Vegh had been pulled from the card due to injury and the match postponed for a later date.{{cite web|url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/attila-vegh-out-of-title-fight-with-christian-mpumbu-at-bellator-84|title=Attila Vegh out of Bellator 84 title fight with champ Christian M'Pumbu|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2012-12-03|access-date=August 7, 2021|archive-date=September 5, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130905075425/http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/attila-vegh-out-of-title-fight-with-christian-mpumbu-at-bellator-84|url-status=dead}}\n\n[[Marcin Held]] and [[Dave Jansen]] were scheduled to compete in the Lightweight Tournament Final on this card. However, the match was cancelled because the Indiana Gaming Commission barred the 20-year-old Held from competing as one must be 21 to enter a casino.{{cite web |url=http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/bjorn-rebney-explains-bellator-84s-removal-of-lightweight-tournament-final |title=Bjorn Rebney Explains Bellator 84's Removal of Lightweight-Tournament Final preceded_by = [[2012 in Bellator MMA|2012]]\n| followed_by = [[2014 in Bellator MMA|2014]]\n}}\n\n'''2013 in Bellator MMA''' was the eighth installment of the [[Bellator MMA]], which began on January 17, 2013 and ended on April 4, 2013.{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/bellator-premieres-jan-17-on-spike-announces-lineups-for-first-two-cards |title=Bellator Premieres Jan. 17th on Spike, Announces Lineups for First Two Cards |date=11 December 2012 |publisher=MMAjunkie.com |access-date=2012-12-11 |archive-date=December 14, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121214080855/http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/bellator-premieres-jan-17-on-spike-announces-lineups-for-first-two-cards |url-status=dead }}\n\n[[Mixed martial arts]] tournaments were held in five [[Mixed martial arts weight classes|weight classes]] and all of the champions, except the heavyweight champion, placed their titles on the line during this season.{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/1418709-bellator-season-8-creating-8-man-tournaments-in-every-division |title=Bellator Season 8: Creating 8-Man Tournaments in Every Division |publisher=bleacherreport.com |date=2012-12-01}}\n\nThis season marked the beginning of Bellator MMA (formerly Bellator Fighting Championships) airing on [[Spike TV]].{{cite web|title=Viacom Purchases Bellator, Spike Will Air Starting 2013|url=http://www.spike.com/articles/lxrtv6/bellator-fighting-championships-viacom-purchases-bellator-spike-will-air-starting-2013|publisher=Spike.com|access-date=7 February 2012}}\n\n==Bellator 85==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=Bellator 85\n|image=\n|date= January 17, 2013\n|venue= [[Bren Events Center]]\n|city= [[Irvine, California]]\n|attendance= 3,002\n}}\n\n'''''Bellator 85''''' took place on January 17, 2013 at the Bren Events Center in Irvine, California. The event was distributed live in prime time by [[Spike TV]]. It marked the season debut of season eight.\n\n'''Background'''\n\nBellator 85 was to open with a fight chosen exclusively by fans in the \"Bellator: Vote For The Fight\" contest. Fans could log onto [[Spike.com]] to select the two fighters they want to see square off in the first ever Bellator bout on Spike TV. The eligible fighters were all welterweights and included [[Paul Daley]], [[Douglas Lima]], [[Ben Saunders (fighter)|Ben Saunders]] and [[War Machine (fighter)|War Machine]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?&ATCLID=205730855&DB_OEM_ID=23600 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130117234453/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?&ATCLID=205730855&DB_OEM_ID=23600 |url-status=dead |archive-date=2013-01-17 |title=Spike TV Presents \"Bellator: Vote For The Fight\" |publisher=bellator.com |date=2012-12-01 }} Initially a bout between Daley and War Machine was announced by Bellator, but it was subsequently cancelled when War Machine tore his ACL and broke his fibula.{{cite web |url=http://www.mmaconvert.com/2012/12/07/war-machine-suffers-broken-leg-out-of-planned-bellator-fight-with-paul-daley/ |title=War Machine Suffers Broken Leg, Out Of Planned Bellator Fight With Paul Daley |publisher=mmaconvert.com |date=2012-12-07 |access-date=December 11, 2012 |archive-date=December 9, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121209061127/http://www.mmaconvert.com/2012/12/07/war-machine-suffers-broken-leg-out-of-planned-bellator-fight-with-paul-daley/ |url-status=dead }}\n\n'''Results'''\n\n{| class=\"toccolours\" style=\"font-size: 85%;\"\n|-\n! The event was distributed live in prime time by [[Spike TV]].{{cite web|url=http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/bellator-89-official-for-feb-14-in-charlotte-with-dantas-galvao-main-event|title=Bellator 89 official for Feb. 14 in Charlotte with Dantas-Galvao main event|work=MMAjunkie|date=21 December 2012|access-date=December 29, 2012|archive-date=December 25, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121225022755/http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2012/12/bellator-89-official-for-feb-14-in-charlotte-with-dantas-galvao-main-event|url-status=dead}}\n\n'''Background'''\n\nBellator 89 featured the opening round of the Middleweight tournament.\n\nThe event also featured the first defense for Eduardo Dantas of the [[List of Bellator champions#Bantamweight Championship|Bantamweight Title]] since he won it from [[Zach Makovsky]] in May 2012. However, Sarnavskiy fractured his hand during his first fight and had to withdraw from the tournament. However, Lima broke his hand and the match was delayed until later in the year.{{cite web|url=http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/03/bellators-douglas-lima-breaks-hand-tourney-final-with-saunders-moves-to-summer|title=Bellator's Douglas Lima Breaks Hand, Tourney Final With Saunders Moves To Summer|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=March 5, 2013|access-date=March 5, 2013|archive-date=March 8, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130308015616/http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/03/bellators-douglas-lima-breaks-hand-tourney-final-with-saunders-moves-to-summer|url-status=dead}}\n\nHeavyweights [[Brett Rogers]] and [[Eric Prindle]] were scheduled to face each other on this card. However, the week leading up to the show it was announced that Prindle had pulled out of the bout due to an injury.\n\nJon Lemke defeated Jesse Erickson to kick off the event for the night and marked Bellator's 800th Fight in the history of the company.\n\n'''Results'''\n\n{| class=\"toccolours\" style=\"font-size: 85%;\"\n|-\n! colspan=\"8\" style=\"background-color: #ccf; color: #000080; The event was distributed live in prime time by [[Spike TV]].\n\n'''Background'''\n\nThe event was initially scheduled to feature a championship match for the [[List of Bellator champions#Featherweight Championship|Featherweight Title]] between [[Pat Curran (fighter)|Pat Curran]] and [[Daniel Mason-Straus]].{{cite web |url=http://www.mmaweekly.com/pat-curran-vs-daniel-straus-headlines-april-4-bellator-card|title= Pat Curran vs. Daniel Straus Headlines April 4 Bellator Card |publisher=mmaweekly.com.com|date=2013-02-06}} However, on February 26, it was announced that Straus had broken his hand and had to pull out of the fight.{{cite RD3-score2=3\n}}\n\n==Bellator 96==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=Bellator 96\n|image=\n|date= June 19, 2013\n|venue= [[Winstar World Casino]]\n|city= [[Thackerville, Oklahoma]]\n}}\n\nBellator 96 took place on June 19, 2013 at the Winstar World Casino in Thackerville, Oklahoma. The event was distributed live in prime time by Spike TV. It marked the season debut of the 2013 summer series.{{cite web|url=http://www.mmafighting.com/2013/4/23/4257460/bellator-books-june-19-summer-series-start-with-king-mo-reality-show|title=Bellator books June 19 summer series start with King Mo, reality show to debut next night |date=23 April 2013 |publisher=mmafighting.com|accessdate=2013-04-23}} [[Randy Couture]], [[Frank Shamrock]], [[Greg Jackson (MMA trainer)|Greg Jackson]] and [[Joe Warren (fighter)|Joe Warren]] took part in commentary.\n\n'''Background'''\n\nBellator 96 featured the opening round of the 2013 Summer Series Heavyweight and Light Heavyweight tournaments.{{cite web|url=http://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Welterweights-War-Machine-Blas-Avena-to-Collide-June-19-at-Bellator-96-in-Oklahoma-52073|title=Welterweights War Machine, Blas Avena to Collide June 19 at Bellator 96 in Oklahoma |publisher=Sherdog.com|date=2013-04-26}}\n\nThis event served as the lead in for the debut of Bellator's new reality TV series, [[Fight Master: Bellator MMA]].\n\n[[Michael Chandler]] was expected to defend his [[List of Bellator champions#Lightweight Championship|Lightweight Title]] against [[Dave Jansen]] on this card. However, on June 2, it was announced that Jansen had to pull out of the bout due to an injury.{{cite web |url=http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/06/dave-jansen-off-bellator-96-david-rickels-meets-michael-chandler-at-bellator-97 |title=Dave Jansen off Bellator 96, David Rickels meets Michael Chandler at Bellator 97 |date=2 June 2013 |publisher=mmajunkie.com |accessdate=2013-06-02 |archive-date=June 8, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130608013243/http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/06/dave-jansen-off-bellator-96-david-rickels-meets-michael-chandler-at-bellator-97 |url-status=dead }}\n\n[[Vinicius Queiroz]] was originally scheduled to face [[Richard Hale (fighter)|Richard Hale]] in the heavyweight tournament. Queiroz, however, suffered a knee injury and was replaced [[Ryan Martinez (fighter)|Ryan Martinez]].{{cite web |url=http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/06/queiroz-off-bellator-96-ryan-martinez-meets-rich-hale-in-heavyweight-tourney |title=Queiroz off Bellator 96, Ryan Martinez meets Rich Hale in heavyweight tourney |publisher=mmajunkie.com |accessdate=2013-06-18 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130621060557/http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/06/queiroz-off-bellator-96-ryan-martinez-meets-rich-hale-in-heavyweight-tourney |archivedate=2013-06-21 }}\n\nBoth [[Derek Campos]] and [[Keith Berry (fighter)|Keith Berry]] missed weight for their fights; as a result, both fighters forfeited a portion of their purses to their opponents and the matches were changed to catchweight.\n\nBoth [[Seth Petruzelli]] & [[Renato Sobral]] retired from MMA competition after this event.\n\n'''Results'''\n\n{| class=\"toccolours\" style=\"font-size: 85%;\"\n|-\n! The event was distributed live in prime time by Spike TV.\n\n'''Background'''\n\nThe card featured Ben Askren's fourth title defense of the [[List of Bellator champions#Welterweight Championship|Bellator Welterweight Championship]] and Michael Chandler's second defense of the [[List of Bellator champions#Lightweight Championship|Bellator Lightweight Championship]].\n\nThe card also featured the [[Heavyweight (MMA)|Heavyweight]] and [[Light Heavyweight (MMA)|Light Heavyweight]] Tournament Finals and [[Bantamweight (MMA)|Bantamweight]] Tournament Semifinals.\n\n[[Douglas Lima]] and [[Ben Saunders (fighter)|Ben Saunders]] were scheduled to fight in order to decide the next contender for the Welterweight title. However, on June 11, it was announced that Lima had to pull out of the bout due to an injury.{{cite web|url=http://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Source-Douglas-Lima-Injured-Scratched-from-Ben-Saunders-Rematch-at-Bellator-97-53195|title=Source: Douglas Lima Injured, Scratched from Ben Saunders Rematch at Bellator 97 |publisher=sherdog.com |accessdate=2013-06-11}}\n\n[[Patricio Freire]] was originally scheduled to face [[The Ultimate Fighter]] veteran [[Rob Emerson]]. However, on July 12, it was revealed Emerson had to withdraw due to injury and was replaced by [[Jared Downing]].{{cite web|url=http://themmareport.com/2013/07/rob-emerson-injured-patricio-pitbull-now-faces-jared-downing-at-bellator-97/|title=Rob Emerson injured, Patricio Pitbull now faces Jared Downing at Bellator 97 |date=12 July 2013 |publisher=theMMAreport.com |accessdate=2013-07-12}}\n\nThe live airing featured the announcement of Bellator's first [[pay per view]] event for November 2, 2013 that will be headlined by [[Tito Ortiz]] versus [[Rampage Jackson|Quinton Jackson]].\n\n'''Results'''\n\n{| class=\"toccolours\" style=\"font-size: 85%;\"\n|-\n! colspan=\"8\" style=\"background-color: #ccf; (fighter)|Anthony Leone]] \n| RD2-score1= '''UD'''\n| RD2-score2= 3\n}}\n\n==Bellator 98==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=Bellator 98\n|image=\n|date= September 7, 2013\n|venue= [[Mohegan Sun Arena]]\n|city= [[Uncasville, Connecticut]]\n}}\n\n'''Bellator 98''' took place on September 7, 2013 at the Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, Connecticut.{{cite web|author=Mohegan Sun Arena|location=Uncasville, Connecticut, United States |url=http://www.sherdog.com/events/Bellator-MMA-Bellator-98-30745 |title=Bellator MMA - Bellator 98 |website=Sherdog.com |date=2013-09-07 |access-date=2015-12-22}} The event aired live in prime time on Spike TV. It marked the season debut of season nine.\n\n'''Background'''\n\nBellator 98 was supposed to feature a [[Bellator Middleweight Championship]] bout between [[Alexander Shlemenko]] and Season 8 Middleweight Tournament Winner [[Doug Marshall]]. However, on August 19 Marshall was forced out of the title bout due to an injury and was replaced by Season 8 Middleweight Tournament Runner Up [[Brett Cooper (fighter)|Brett Cooper]].{{cite web |last=Erickson |first=Matt |url=http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/08/brett-cooper-replaces-doug-marshall-faces-champ-shlemenko-at-bellator-98 |title=Brett Cooper replaces Doug Marshall, faces champ Shlemenko at Bellator 98 |website=MMAjunkie.com |date=2013-08-19 |access-date=2015-12-22 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131110131957/http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/08/brett-cooper-replaces-doug-marshall-faces-champ-shlemenko-at-bellator-98 |archive-date=2013-11-10 }}\n\nThe [[Fight Master: Bellator MMA]] finale between [[Joe Riggs]] and [[Mike Bronzoulis]] was expected to take place at this event. However, on September 3, it was revealed Riggs has sustained a significant eye injury and the bout was postponed indefinitely.{{cite web |url=http://mma-boxing.si.com/2013/09/03/bellator-fight-master-finale-bout-postponed-saturday/?sct=mma_t2_a1 |title=Saturday's 'Fight Master' finale bout postponed - Counter Punch - SI.com |website=Mma-boxing.si.com |date=2013-09-03 |access-date=2015-12-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131104075139/http://mma-boxing.si.com/2013/09/03/bellator-fight-master-finale-bout-postponed-saturday/?sct=mma_t2_a1 |archive-date=2013-11-04 |url-status=dead }} The fight was later scheduled for [[Bellator 106]].\n\n[[Dan Cramer]] was originally scheduled to face [[Perry Filkins]] in the Middleweight tournament opening round, but withdrew from the match and was replaced by Jeremy Kimball.\n\n[[Joe Warren (fighter)|Joe Warren]] was scheduled to face Nick Kirk on this card. However, on the Friday before the event, Warren was removed for undisclosed medical reasons. The fight was later scheduled for [[Bellator 101]]\n\n[[Andreas Spang]] was originally scheduled to face [[Justin Torrey]] in the Middleweight tournament opening round, but was declared unfit to fight by the Mohegan Tribe Department of Athletic Regulation. He was replaced by [[Brennan Ward]], who originally was supposed to face [[Dave Vitkay]] on the preliminary card.{{cite web |last=Erickson |first=Matt |url=http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/09/andreas-spang-ruled-out-of-bellator-98-justin-torrey-meets-brennan-ward |title=Andreas Spang ruled out of Bellator 98, Justin Torrey meets Brennan Ward |website=MMAjunkie.com |date=2013-09-06 |access-date=2015-12-22 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131109161543/http://www.mmajunkie.com/news/2013/09/andreas-spang-ruled-out-of-bellator-98-justin-torrey-meets-brennan-ward |archive-date=2013-11-09 }}\n\n[[Andrew Calandrelli]] was originally scheduled to face [[Ryan Quinn]], but was removed from the card and replaced by [[Brylan Van Artsdalen]].\n\nThe card featured all the Middleweight Tournament Quarterfinal bouts.\n\n'''Results'''\n\n{| class=\"toccolours\" style=\"font-size: 85%;\"\n|-\n! However, on August 18, it was announced that M'Pumbu had a hand injury and he was replaced by [[Houston Alexander]].{{cite web|url=http://www.mmaweekly.com/bellator-99-full-fight-card-released-houston-alexander-steps-in-to-face-vladimir-matyushenko |title=Bellator 99 Full Fight Card Released; Houston Alexander Steps In to Face Vladimir Matyushenko |website=MMAWeekly.com |date=2013-08-18 |access-date=2015-12-22}}\n\n[[Shahbulat Shamhalaev]] was originally scheduled to face [[Akop Stepanyan]] on this card. However, on September 9, it was revealed Shamhalaev was forced to pull out of the tournament due to his ailing father. He was replaced by [[Justin Wilcox (martial arts)|Justin Wilcox]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?&ATCLID=209255774&DB_OEM_ID=23600 |title=Shahbulat Shamhalaev Withdraws from Featherweight Tournament, Justin Wilcox Now Faces Akop Stepanyan September 13th from Pechanga Resort - Bellator MMA |website=www.bellator.com |access-date=17 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131104005509/http://www.bellator.com/ViewArticle.dbml?&ATCLID=209255774&DB_OEM_ID=23600 |archive-date=4 November 2013 |url-status=dead}}\n\nA bantamweight bout between Derek Loffer and Mario Navarro was initially planned for this card, but cancelled for unknown reasons.{{cite web|url=http://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/bouts/bellator-99-derek-loffer-vs-mario-handsome-navarro |title=Derek Loffer vs. Mario Navarro, Bellator 99 | MMA Bout Page |publisher=Tapology |date=2013-09-13 |access-date=2015-12-22}}\n\n'''Results'''\n\n{| class=\"toccolours\" style=\"font-size: 85%;\"\n|-\n! He was replaced by [[Ron Keslar]].{{cite web|url=http://www.mmafighting.com/2013/9/16/4736268/ron-keslar-replaces-matt-riddle-at-bellator-100 |title=Ron Keslar replaces Matt Riddle at Bellator 100 |publisher=MMA Fighting |date=2013-09-16 |access-date=2015-12-22}}\n\nMark Scanlon was originally scheduled to face [[Herman Terrado]] on this card, but pulled out due to an injury and was replaced by [[Rick Hawn]]\n\n'''Results'''\n\n{| class=\"toccolours\" style=\"font-size: 85%;\"\n|-\n!
